instances.claim: This tells me that the work consists of a bounded edition of individually identical physical Cent objects, issued and held by named participants, whose membership the film has fixed.

Each line parses because the earlier lines supply a cent in the singular; together they presuppose a plural, enumerated, distributed set that no line introduces.
